design_condition: Set back toward the north and west while running parallel to the street, the volume creates a raised forecourt and side square, fits the neighboring school scale, but leaves the surrounding open space constrained.

positive.statement: The building height fits well into the context of the neighboring schools.
The raised forecourt effectively stands out from the street.
The rooms appear to be of high quality and appropriate for use.
The skylights give the deep building a certain permeability and lightness.
The building shell is convincingly constructed in energy terms.
The fine grid takes away the heaviness of the large volume.
The project implements sustainability requirements well in construction and operation.

negative.statement: The access to the sports hall appears too prominent on the main facade.
The exterior is schematic and minimalist, without special qualities.
There is no significant dialogue between ground-floor uses and the open space.
The outdoor seating on the shady and drafty side is doubtful in quality.
The proposed stairwell closure and escape route are not plausible.
The supporting structure has significant deficits that could have spatial consequences.
A more identifying face for the vocational school would be desirable.
